description:
What You'll be Owning 

 GRVTY is seeking a Web Developer with a TS/SCI + Poly clearance (applicable to this customer) to join one of our top projects in McLean, VA. The Sponsor requires web design services. The Web Developer will research, design, build, monitor, and enhance websites in various frameworks, with an emphasis on backend security and encryption. The work will be performed independently as part of a larger team effort in a collaborative environment. The Web Developer will research, design, build, monitor, and enhance websites in various frameworks including WordPress, GoDaddy’s website builder, Joomla, Wix, Express.js, Next.js or similar. The Web Developer will work with Sponsor to identify, develop, and produce content using CSS, JS, PHP and similar. The Web Developer will implement modern encryption algorithms to mitigate website vulnerabilities and harden website and cloud environment security. The Web Developer will perform basic review of web traffic or logs and ensure website analytic capability.

 What You Must Have 

 
 Active TS/SCI with Polygraph Clearance

 Demonstrated experience with web design and general principles of the Internet.

 Demonstrated experience with WordPress to include setting up a basic hosting environment, installing WordPress, building a WordPress site, and adding additional functionality to the site via commercially-available plugins.

 Demonstrated experience in writing copy for websites and blogs and the ability to adapt and create content for websites of various topics or industries.

 Demonstrated experience using Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), JavaScript, and PHP (Hypertext Preprocessor web programming language).

 Demonstrated experience mitigating website vulnerabilities and hardening website and cloud environment security

 Demonstrated experience in implementing modern encryption algorithms into software applications.

 Demonstrated experience understanding and conveying technical concepts and language to a nontechnical audience, via website content development or through briefings or print material.

 
 What Would be Nice to Have 

 
 Demonstrated experience with other web development frameworks including GoDaddy’s website builder, Joomla, Wix, Express.js, Next.js or other similar platforms.

 Demonstrated experience of website penetration testing and "red teaming".

 Demonstrated experience with other common industry tools, such as email marketing platforms, social media marketing/management tools, website analytics, and other industry trends

 
 
  



  

  

  
 

 Pay Range: At GRVTY, we understand that compensation is influenced by many factors—such as geographic location, federal contract labor categories, wage rates, prior experience, skillsets, education, and certifications.
We’re proud to offer a work environment that empowers our team to achieve a strong work-life balance. GRVTY provides competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for professional growth.
Our benefits package is designed to support the well-being of our employees and their families, and includes coverage in areas such as healthcare, financial wellness, retirement planning, family assistance, continued education, and paid time off.

  

 

 Virginia Pay Range
 $150,000 — $250,000 USD 


 Why Choose GRVTY 

 
 The toughest national security challenges demand vision and ingenuity, not just resources. We deliver mission and technical expertise to outpace our adversaries. We’re purpose-built to tackle the most entrenched, systemic national security issues around the world.

 We partner with our customers to help them overcome challenges in every corner of technology and defense—including the ones still being explored. Our growing capabilities create complementary advantages, giving on-the-ground operations the edge they need to succeed. We muster everything we have to answer every challenge presented, every day of our lives.

 At GRVTY, we believe that when our employees thrive, our company thrives. That’s why we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

 •    Robust health plan including medical, dental, and vision  

 •    Health Savings Account with company contribution  

 •    Annual Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays  

 •    Paid Parental Leave   

 •    401k with generous company match  

 •    Training and Development Opportunities  

 •    Award Programs
